_published_faq.name: How do I add Blossom Hill to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Blossom Hill to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://calm-steel-fqshc.run.mcp-use.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Blossom Hill MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 7, 2026, Blossom Hill scores 90/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.
